categories.main_business_segments: Fuan Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, focusing on chemical drug research, production, and sales. Its business covers the full industry chain including pharmaceutical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and finished dosage forms. Key product categories include antibiotics, anti-tumor drugs, and specialty drugs. The company also engages in drug development and exports products internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies adhering strictly to GMP standards. It integrates R&D with production, utilizing continuous innovation in drug formulation and process optimization. The production model is mainly 'sales-driven manufacturing' with quality control and safety management systems in place. The company also engages in contract manufacturing for other pharmaceutical firms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Fuan Pharmaceutical's primary customers are hospitals and pharmaceutical distributors across China, with a growing presence in export markets. The company targets end markets including anti-infective, oncology, respiratory, and digestive system treatments. It participates actively in national and provincial centralized drug procurement programs, supplying high-quality generic drugs to public healthcare institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are mainly concentrated in China, covering most provinces with significant sales in East China, Central China, North China, Southwest China, and other regions. Export sales constitute a smaller portion of revenue but are expanding. The company also has subsidiaries and R&D centers in key Chinese cities such as Chongqing, Ningbo, and Yantai, and maintains some international market activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fuan Pharmaceutical operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It controls the entire value chain from chemical intermediates and APIs production to finished drug formulations and sales. The company also engages in R&D and drug registration, positioning itself as a fully integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing R&D on anti-tumor, anti-infective, and digestive system drugs. It pursues a strategy of 'producing one generation, developing one generation, pre-researching one generation, and reserving one generation' to maintain continuous innovation. R&D efforts combine independent innovation with collaborative research and product introduction, aiming to enhance product competitiveness and meet regulatory standards such as consistency evaluation and drug registration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products including APIs, intermediates, and finished dosage forms. Sales are conducted via direct sales to manufacturers and hospitals, as well as through distributors and agents. The company also earns income from contract manufacturing services and investment returns from equity holdings. Participation in government centralized procurement programs influences pricing and sales volume.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fuan Pharmaceutical is positioned as a competitive mid-sized player within China's pharmaceutical manufacturing sector, recognized among the top 100 in drug R&D and chemical drug manufacturing. It competes with other domestic generic drug manufacturers, especially in antibiotics and oncology drugs. The company leverages its full industry chain and product portfolio diversity to maintain market share amid intense competition and pricing pressures from national procurement policies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.39 billion, a 9.68% decrease from the previous year, while net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 20.69% to RMB 279.8 million. Total assets stood at about RMB 5.98 billion with stable net assets around RMB 4.4 billion. The company maintains steady growth with increasing R&D investment and improved profitability despite market challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fuan Pharmaceutical emphasizes its comprehensive industry chain integration from intermediates to finished drugs, enabling cost advantages and quality control. It highlights its strong R&D capabilities, product diversity across key therapeutic areas, and compliance with national quality and regulatory standards. The company’s active participation in centralized procurement and focus on high-value generic drugs provide competitive differentiation by balancing affordability with efficacy and safety.
